prompt.project_info: Create a high-resolution red-carpet or gala portrait with a glamorous black sequin evening-gown styling and warm event atmosphere.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused warm event lighting flatters the face and creates controlled sparkle across the gown; natural skin texture, refined red-carpet glamour, warm champagne and gold atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution editorial portrait photography, full-frame 85mm prime-lens look, shallow depth of field, sharp facial focus, realistic sequin reflections, natural proportions, no visible text or logos.
